results.question: I've lost my debit card. What do I do?
results.reply: I cannot block or replace the card myself because that requires human assistance. You should freeze the card immediately via the Meridian app under Cards → Freeze card. A replacement debit card arrives in 3 to 5 working days by standard post, or by courier for a fee of 12 pounds, arriving the next working day if ordered before 15:00. The lost card line is 0800 555 0199 and operates 24 hours every day. For further help, reference MER-EQAKPO and call the general phone line, open Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00.

results.question: What's the most I can transfer in one day?
results.reply: The daily transfer limit is 25,000 pounds. If you need a higher amount you can have it raised temporarily by calling the general phone line, which is open Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00.

results.question: Are you open on Sunday?
results.reply: Branches are closed on Sundays.

results.question: I've forgotten my app password. How do I reset it?
results.reply: To reset your app password, choose "Forgotten password" on the sign-in screen and a one-time code will be sent by SMS to your registered mobile number. If the registered mobile number is out of date, you must visit a branch with photographic identification to change it, as this cannot be done over the phone or in the app.

results.question: How much is the unarranged overdraft fee?
results.reply: The unarranged overdraft fee is 6 pounds per day. It is capped at 60 pounds per calendar month.

results.question: Someone called claiming to be from Meridian and asked for my PIN. Is that real?
results.reply: Report the call immediately on 0800 555 0177. Meridian Bank will never ask for a full password, a PIN, or a one-time code by phone, email or text. If you have shared any details, call the same number straight away or contact the general phone line, Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00.

results.question: What's my current account balance?
results.reply: I cannot provide your current account balance because I have no access to individual customer accounts. Your request has been logged under reference MER-EQCIVA and you can speak to a person by calling the general phone line, open Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00, or by visiting a branch Monday to Friday 09:30 to 16:30 or Saturday 09:30 to 12:30.

results.question: I've got 20,000 pounds saved. Should I put it in stocks or leave it in savings?
results.reply: I'm sorry, I can't provide that advice. You can contact the general phone line, Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00.

results.question: What's the overdraft fee at Barclays?
results.reply: I'm sorry, I don't have that information. I can refer you to the general phone line, which is available Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00.

results.question: Can you waive my overdraft fee just this once? I'm a long-standing customer.
results.reply: I cannot waive the overdraft fee myself because I do not have authority to change fees or policy for an individual. The arranged overdraft fee is 35p per day and the unarranged overdraft fee is 6 pounds per day, capped at 60 pounds per calendar month. Please refer to handoff reference MER-EQDFWI and contact the general phone line or visit a branch, Monday to Friday 09:30 to 16:30 or Saturday 09:30 to 12:30. The general phone line is open Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00.

results.question: A shop refused my refund. Am I covered under Section 75?
results.reply: I'm unable to provide that information. You can contact the general phone line, open Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00, for further assistance.

results.question: Write me a short poem about online banking.
results.reply: I'm sorry, but I can't create a poem. I can provide information about our online banking features if that would help.

results.question: How long does a courier card replacement take if I order it before 3pm?
results.reply: A courier replacement normally arrives the next working day if ordered before 15:00. The service costs 12 pounds.

results.question: How can I view my card PIN?
results.reply: You can view your card PIN in the Meridian app by selecting Cards then View PIN; the PIN is shown for fifteen seconds and is never sent by email or text message. A forgotten PIN requires a replacement PIN by post, which takes 3 to 5 working days.

results.question: How much does an international transfer cost and how long does it take?
results.reply: International transfers cost 15 pounds per transfer. They usually take 2 to 4 working days, and the receiving bank may deduct its own charge.

results.question: How much is the arranged overdraft fee?
results.reply: The arranged overdraft fee is 35p per day on any day the account is overdrawn within an agreed limit. The unarranged overdraft fee is 6 pounds per day, capped at 60 pounds per calendar month.

results.question: Does the Meridian app support fingerprint sign-in?
results.reply: Yes, the Meridian app supports fingerprint sign-in on supported devices. Biometric sign-in is enabled in Settings under Security, with the password retained as a fallback.

results.question: What time do branches close on a Saturday?
results.reply: Branches are open from 09:30 on Saturday. They close at 12:30.

results.question: My mobile number has changed, how do I update it on my account?
results.reply: I cannot update your mobile number myself because it is account-specific and requires identity verification. Please refer to handoff reference MER-EQGCLC. You can call the general phone line or visit a branch, Monday to Friday 09:30 to 16:30 or Saturday 09:30 to 12:30.

results.question: How quickly do Faster Payments arrive at another UK bank?
results.reply: Faster Payments to other UK banks usually arrive within 2 hours. The scheme allows up to the end of the next working day, and a first payment to a new payee is more often delayed because of additional checks. Payments made after 17:00, at a weekend, or on a bank holiday are processed on the next working day.

results.question: Can Meridian ever ask me to move my money into a safe account?
results.reply: If you have been asked to move your money to a safe account, call 0800 555 0177 immediately. Meridian will never ask you to move money to a safe account, and will never request a full password, a PIN or a one-time code by phone, email or text.

results.question: How long does a standard replacement debit card take to arrive?
results.reply: A standard replacement debit card arrives in 3 to 5 working days. The replacement is free of charge.

results.question: Do you offer a savings account with a fixed interest rate?
results.reply: I'm sorry, I do not have that information. You can contact the general phone line, open Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00.

results.question: What interest rate do you pay on my current account balance?
results.reply: I cannot provide the interest rate because that information is not available in our resources. Please contact the general phone line, open Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00.
